info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of available rideshare drivers. This endpoint is designed for mobile applications and web platforms that require up-to-date information on drivers in a given area. Users can query the service to find and interact with drivers based on their location and availability. Typical consumers include rideshare applications and transportation services that seek to optimize user experience by delivering real-time driver data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of rides associated with a specific driver. It provides detailed information about the rides, enabling drivers to track their scheduled pickups and drop-offs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving driver ride information. This request does not require a body but this section is included for completeness. The API allows for querying ride details associated with a specific driver.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the driver's ride information.
